verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase delivers AI-generated insights in the Firebase console from the user's own project data. For Crashlytics crashes it gives an issue description, possible root causes and fix suggestions. For messaging campaigns it summarizes and analyzes performance and offers actionable recommendations, alongside a natural-language chat for troubleshooting. Missing for 10: AI insights over core app data such as Firestore or Analytics contents are not evidenced (coverage is limited to crash and campaign data), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
